candidate.explanation: Conventional dictionary-backed ledger with immutable request receipts and an incremental Kahn dependency scheduler. Checkpoints use standard pickle plus zlib; restore rebuilds transient dependency indexes from canonical definitions and completed values.

Separate ledger receipt/balance maps and immutable dependency definitions. Incremental reverse-edge scheduling runs each newly ready node once; no recursion or repeated graph scans. Compressed pickle checkpoints preserve canonical state and scheduling state, including original receipts and pending edges. Restore is direct deserialization within the execution boundary.
